IMPORT_VANILLA_SAVES-IMPORT_BUTTON.label: Import Vanilla Profile
IMPORT_VANILLA_SAVES-IMPORT_CONFIRM_POPU:
Press a button below to choose which vanilla profile to import from.



All data in [gold]Modded Save Profile {ModdedProfile}[/gold] will be lost, and it will be replaced by the data from [gold]Unmodded Save Profile {VanillaProfile}[/gold].

[red]This cannot be undone.[/red]
IMPORT_VANILLA_SAVES-EXPORT_BUTTON.label: Export Modded Profile
IMPORT_VANILLA_SAVES-EXPORT_CONFIRM_POPU:
Press a button below to choose which modded profile to export.



All data in [gold]Vanilla Save Profile {VanillaProfile}[/gold] will be lost, and it will be replaced by the data from [gold]Modded Save Profile {ModdedProfile}[/gold].

[red]This cannot be undone.[/red]
